key_themes: Consumer confidence collapsed to 12-year low (81.9 in September, worst since 2014), stoking inflation and rate-hike fears
FICO credit-score monopoly disrupted: Fannie/Freddie open mortgage pricing to VantageScore rival, crushing FICO shares 26%
AI M&A wave intensifies: AMD acquires Fei-Fei Li's World Labs for $8.2B in all-stock deal to challenge Nvidia in physical AI

stocks.reason: Shares plunged ~26% after FHFA head Bill Pulte announced Fannie/Freddie will adopt unified mortgage pricing model incorporating VantageScore 4.0 (TransUnion), ending FICO mortgage credit-score dominance
Shares surged 30%+ after raising 2026 revenue guidance to $410M-$420M (from $350M-$370M), beating $402.8M consensus, on accelerating Amtagvi demand; Goldman Sachs resumed Buy at $15

Shares surged ~11% on record Q3 results: non-GAAP EPS $1.43 vs $1.35 est, revenue $8.44B vs $8.39B est; all-time high net income $1.9B; raised FY2026 EPS guidance to $2.24; 2027 bookings at record levels

Shares rose ~12% on Jefferies PT raise to $264 from $229 citing $25B Brookfield financing deal and 2GW capacity target, plus sustained AI data-center power demand following S&P 500 inclusion on Sept 21

In focus after announcing $8.2B all-stock acquisition of World Labs (Fei-Fei Li AI startup); Li joins as Chief Scientist and EVP; escalates AMD rivalry with Nvidia in physical AI and robotics simulation
Q2 earnings beat: EPS $1.16 vs $0.73 est (+59% beat); revenue $7.88B vs $7.06B est; retail/wholesale unit sales up 14.7% YoY; company plans to resume buybacks in Q4 FY2026
Shares active after TD Cowen initiated coverage with Buy rating; Starship successfully reached orbit deploying 26 Starlink satellites and performed controlled landing burn in Pacific Ocean
Upgraded to Buy from Hold at Deutsche Bank with $95 price target; stock down 22% YTD after WBD deal collapse, Deutsche Bank sees current valuation as buying opportunity
Downgraded to Sell by Argus; Paramount Skydance acquisition at $31/share now imminent following antitrust clearance, with spread effectively closed leaving minimal upside from current price
Downgraded by J.P. Morgan from Overweight to Neutral; price target cut 19% to $138; North America salty snacks (Frito-Lay) underperforming despite international FIFA World Cup momentum
Upgraded to Buy from Hold at Melius Research with $80 price target; analyst sees improving competitive positioning and valuation upside in grocery as consumers trade down amid inflation
